findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a few broken tiles under the three compartment sink within the bar area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that the broken tiles are replaced providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine was observed to contain an accumulation of mold.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure ice machine is cleaned regularly.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The pizza ovens were observed to have an accumulation of food and grease debris. Ensure these surfaces are removed from the oven and put through a wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. Perform these actions at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of the debris.

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking of the hand sink is no longer existent. Where the sink meets the wall there is a gap present. Apply caulking to the area to seal the gap and create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: No certified food protection manager certificate (as per 11/8/18 inspection). Provide proof of CFPM or contact Kevin Dreesman to apply for a variance to be a low risk establishment and serve pizza. 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Facility has chlorine test strips, but uses quaternary ammonium sanitizer tablets. Provide quaternary ammonium test strips for testing the concentration of sanitizer.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom tray of the pizza oven to be soiled with food debris and char. Clean the bottom tray. Observed the outside of the soda gun nozzle to be soiled black. Scrub and clean this nozzle.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
No paper towels were available at the hand washing sink in the kitchen. Maintain a supply of soap, warm water and paper towels at each hand sink.
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed the side door with the Busch Stadium sign above the door to have a gap at the bottom of the door where sunlight shines through. There is also a gap around the small window air conditioning unit above the ice machine. Seal outer openings to prevent pest entry. New door is reported to be on order and building is to be re-sided at some point.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom wall next to the fryers/three compartment sink to be in disrepair with paint soiled and peeling and a hole in the wall. The wall behind the Snapple reach in cooler has been torn out due to an electrical fire last Sunday. Clean and repair walls.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
No proof of certified food manager. Under the FDA Food Code, the person in charge at the time of the inspection will be required to have this certification. Jeff states that he has this, and he will need to contact ServSafe to get a copy of his valid certificate. Email inspector a copy of the certified food manager certificate within the next 90 days.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no test kit to test sanitizer. Provide a sanitizer test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) REPEATX2-Floor to wall juncture around ice machine was not properly sealed. Provide proper seal at the floor to wall juncture. 2)Drain underneath the three compartment sink was soiled with dirt accumulation. Clean drain. 3)Observed a hole in the floor next to the fryers. Seal hole. 
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

1) Ceiling above the walk in cooler was peeling off. Repair ceiling. 2) Bottom of the wall next to the fryers/three compartment sink was in disrepair/peeling off/discoloration. Repair/reseal/repaint wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the microwave to be soiled (top,sides,bottom) with food debris. Wash, rinse, and sanitize food contact surface.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed box of paper towels stored on the floor in area next to walk in cooler. Store single service items 6 inches or higher off the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

Seal hand sink to wall. 3)Ceiling in room with ice machine and dry storage is starting to peel. Repair ceiling so it is smooth and easily cleanable.
